replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I'm sorry to say but your map has been denied for the following reasons

Block palette is unoriginal and bland. Spice it up
Islands are blocky and ununique
Need more islands/pathways to reduce the amount of void (more pvp space). Because of the large void space, its harder to rush as the monuments are really close to the spawn.

You may resubmit your map once you completely edit the things we mentioned
